description_en: Queries the status of a task of any type
description_zh: 查询任务状态，可以查询所有类型任务状态
name: GetTaskStatus

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostics details returned when a permission check fails, including the authenticated principal, action, policy, and denial reason
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The action that triggered the access denied error. You can use this information to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authenticated principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authenticated principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authenticated principal, such as a RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the access denied error. An account administrator with the required permissions can decode this message to troubleshoot the denial reason
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the access denied reason, which distinguishes between implicit denial and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the access denied error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the task execution fails

ErrorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the task execution fails
ErrorMsg.description_zh: 任务执行失败错误消息
ErrorMsg.title_en: 任务执行失败错误消息
ErrorMsg.title_zh: 任务执行失败错误消息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which corresponds to the requestId request parameter

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
init: Not started.
processing: Processing.
failed: Failed.
succeed: Completed.
canceled: Canceled
Status.description_zh: 未开始 :init 处理中 : processing    失败 :failed   完成 :succeed  取消 :canceled
Status.title_en: 未开始 :init 处理中 : processing    失败 :failure   完成 :succeed  取消 :canceled
Status.title_zh: 未开始 :init 处理中 : processing    失败 :failure   完成 :succeed  取消 :canceled

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

Type.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
wall_line: Wall line prediction.
cut_image: Image cutting.
build: Reconstruction.
right_angle_optimization: Right-angle optimization.
other: Other
Type.description_zh: 墙线预测：wall_line 切图：cut_image 重建：build 直角优化：right_angle_optimization 其他：other
Type.title_en: 墙线预测: wall_line 切图: cut_image   重建: build  直角优化：right_angle_optimization  其他：other
Type.title_zh: 墙线预测: wall_line 切图: cut_image   重建: build  直角优化：right_angle_optimization  其他：other
